senses.gloss:
निज् निज्, ii. 3, Par. Ātm.
 1. To cleanse, MBh. 7, 8531.
 2. † To nourish.
 --With the prep. निस् निस्, निर्णिक्त,
 1. Sprinkled, Man. 5, 127.
 2. Polished, Bhāg. P. 3, 28, 27.
 3. Purified, MBh. 12, 9735.
 4. Cleared up, explained, Hariv. 11220.
 --With परिनिस् परि-निस्, To wash, MBh. 5, 1399.
 --Cf. probably νίζω.
निज नि-ज (vb. जन्), adj. Own, Man. 2, 50.
